# Learning Record Format

Store records in `learning-records/`. Use the next four-digit number in
each file name, for example `0001-topic.md`.

```md
# {What the user learned}

{State what the user can do, the evidence, and why it changes the next lesson.}
```

Write a record when the user demonstrates a skill, states prior knowledge,
corrects a misconception, or changes the mission. Do not record material
that the lesson only covered.

If new evidence corrects an older record, mark the old record
`Status: superseded by LR-NNNN` and add the new record. Keep the history
so later lessons can follow the change.
